title: Would Your Kid Tap It? Uncle Himal on AI, Scams and Money for Kids
description:
▶️ Watch a full episode, Diyo Wants ALL the Money! Kiran's Three Jars: https://youtu.be/z2FWrEyPaXQ

A prize pops up. Diyo taps it. Would your kid?

When we were kids there was no AI and no pop ups. Our kids live with both. Half of U.S. teens have used a chatbot for schoolwork. Kids under 20 filed 31,254 internet crime reports last year. By age 7, money basics are already forming.

Diyo Kids teaches the skills school skips. Short cartoons. One real skill each. Money, passwords, scams, AI. One rule per episode. Say it with them.

▶️ All episodes: https://www.youtube.com/@diyokidstv
📖 The book, Kiran's Three Jars: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKZR92MX

Sources: Pew Research Center, How Teens Use and View AI, Feb 2026. FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center, 2025 Annual Report. Whitebread and Bingham, University of Cambridge, 2013.

title: The Call That Sounded Exactly Like Her Son
description: AI voice-cloning "emergency" calls. Scammers copy a family member's voice from about 3 seconds of social-media audio, then call a parent or grandparent: "Mum, I've had an accident, I need money now." The FBI links $352M in losses among older people to AI scams.
